branch_program:
conditional: learned state transformation
  shape: 3 operand(s) of W bits -> W bits
  vector program (state example search), disassembled from its tensors:
    r0 = input x0
    r1 = input x1
    r2 = input x2
    r3 = zero
    r4 = one
    r5 = zero
    r6 = zero
    @0: (test only); if r2 != 0 goto @1 else halt
    @1: r5 = file.read(r0)
    @2: r6 = file.write(r1, r5)
    result = r6

loop_program:
repeat: learned state transformation
  shape: 2 operand(s) of W bits -> W bits
  vector program (state example search), disassembled from its tensors:
    r0 = input x0
    r1 = input x1
    r2 = zero
    r3 = one
    r4 = zero
    r5 = zero
    @0: (test only); if r1 != 0 goto @1 else halt
    @1: r1 = advance(r1)
    @2: r5 = file.read(r0); if r1 != 0 goto @1 else halt
    result = r1
  learned from 3 training cases and 2 validation cases; 2 steps, 147 candidates
scope: one guard or one numeric-feedback while region; optional observed host-effect traces
trace_note: Repeated reads leave the same final files; demonstrated effects supply otherwise missing evidence.
